verdict.rationale: Webhooks are a fair question for a SaaS documentation platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks for Mintlify events. Automations run on pushes or integration events (inbound triggers), the REST API returns a status ID for polling, and Slack status updates are chat notifications, which do not qualify.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
